pairs.why: Both feeders pair a bright orange roof with a dark trunk and a mid-value background, so value and contrast give no reason to choose.
A's floor is lighter and its interior shadows are softer, which is nearer the real card's pale floor and its orange hero against a mid purple wall; B's floor is darker.
B has a dark navy body with bright cyan accents and darker orange corners, like the real card's dark hero on a glowing yellow ground; A's cream keys lift the hero's key and flatten the contrast.
A has gentler local contrast and a lighter, smoother overall key, close to the real card's soft cream sails on a mid purple ground; B's sea is darker and its sail shading harder.
B has a darker upper background with a stronger vignette and a bright white crown, matching the real card's dark wall and clear hero separation; A's backdrop is flatter and mid-orange.
A has a slightly lighter, more yellow centre glow, closer to the real card's light striped ground; B's edges are heavier orange and darker.
Both are brighter than the real card, with the same pale sky, mid grey table and similar shadows, so nothing separates them on value.
B's dark blue body with a few bright cyan keys and darker orange corners matches the real card's value structure; A's light keys break up the dark mass.
